verdict.rationale: Kit lists 'Unlimited Visual Automations' and RSS campaigns, and supports scheduled broadcasts, so marketing automations run on their own once configured. Webhooks with automatic retries, an API for automating tasks, and an MCP server that turns natural-language prompts into account actions add programmatic and AI-driven hooks. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on how the visual automation builder works (triggers, conditions, sequences), evidence of AI-agent-driven automations that run unattended rather than prompt-by-prompt, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
